reason: Go restricts native tool ids to a closed set of compiled parsers (claude-code, codex, claude-desktop): an id outside that set names a parser Go has never compiled, so it rejects it ("Unknown compiled native parser."). The Rust validator only checked the id's token syntax, accepting any well-formed but unrecognized id; since fixed (endpoint/src/detection.rs validate()) to enforce the same closed set for both id and parser.
